origin.value: the bundled order document via a file URL
origin.example: {src <- xml2_example("order-doc.xml"); dest <- tempfile(); download_html(paste0("file://", src), dest); paste(readLines(dest), collapse = "\n")}

translation.value: the bundled order document via a file URL
translation.example: import tempfile; src = xml2_example("order-doc.xml"); dest = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False).name; download_html("file://" + src, dest); open(dest).read().rstrip("\n")
